parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use correct trigonometric formulae and express the equation in terms of $\tan\theta$ - M1. Obtain a correct equation in $\tan\theta$ in any form, for example $\frac{1-\tan^2\theta}{2\tan\theta}+\frac1{\tan\theta}=2$ - A1. Reduce to $\tan^2\theta+4\tan\theta-3=0$, or a three-term equivalent - A1. Printed total: 3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Solve a three-term quadratic for $\tan\theta$ and calculate $\theta$ - M1; $\tan\theta=-2\pm\sqrt7$. Obtain $0.573$ - A1; must be 3 d.p. Obtain $1.783$ and no other answer - A1. Guidance: ignore answers outside the interval; degrees are a misread ($32.9^\circ,102.1^\circ$). Printed total: 3.
